$comment: GENERATED by native/contract/tools/build-engine-api.mjs from engine-api.spec.mjs, app/js/shared/params.js and the instrument registry. Do not edit by hand. Prose: native/docs/ENGINE_CONTRACT.md.

clock.engineTime: seconds = frames rendered by the core / sampleRate since engine creation; monotonic; continues across device restarts; pauses while asleep
clock.when: engine seconds; absent/null/<= render position ⇒ first frame of the next block; later ⇒ sample-accurate at round(when*sr); internal timers on 128-frame quanta
clock.currentTime: shim: t_tick + (performance.now() - perfAtReceive)/1000, capped at t_tick + 0.25 s, never decreasing
clock.midiDirect: CoreMIDI host time → frame, + one block fixed delay when route.jitterFree

methods.name: start
methods.effect: context, graph, registry, first IR, comp makeup; statechange + ready{start}

methods.name: restart
methods.effect: new context, state re-applied, decoded samples kept, statechange{restarted:true}; invalidates prepare tokens

methods.name: prepare
methods.effect: build/reuse instruments, decode, stage reverb (deferred while playing); loading events

methods.name: commit
methods.effect: gapless swap: retire old channels, new routing, slot cfgs, FX, wheels, drone.songChanged

methods.name: setBufferFrames
methods.effect: recorded synchronously; travels with the next audio start/restart

methods.name: setDroneFreeze
methods.effect: true = the drone plays a frozen loop while low-resource is on (1.x); false = always the live drone (DECISIONS D5)

methods.name: getParam
methods.effect: the value the engine holds (PARAMS value space: number, boolean, enum name, 'natural'); undefined for an empty slot or an unset optional row

bridge.local: no-op: native state survives device restarts

notContract.name: at
notContract.reason: test hook (31 test files); golden scripts use timed messages instead

notContract.name: lowResource
notContract.reason: getter read by tests only (the app keeps its own flag)

notContract.name: _fade
notContract.reason: perform.js fallback when getRuntimeState is missing

grammar.clamp: bool: booleans, numbers >= .5, true/on/1; enum: member or rounded index; number: Number(v), NaN/null/"" → default, clamped, rounded when step 1; words pass; dynamic: booleans pass, numbers clamped to instrument meta

transport.batching: native → JS: one message or an ordered array per main-thread turn

envelope.request: {v:1, op, id?, ...args}  — with id: exactly one reply; without: fire-and-forget (errors → warn event)
envelope.reply: {v:1, re:id, ok:true, result} | {v:1, re:id, ok:false, error:{code, message, detail?}}
envelope.ids: positive integers, unique per page load; replies may arrive out of order
envelope.ordering: native applies JS messages strictly FIFO on one control queue; async work completes later without blocking it

messages.versioning: hello first; unknown fields ignored both ways; additive = minor + capability string; breaking = new v; mismatched v → error protocol
